events.sql:
SELECT 
    t.*,
    ra.transaction_pattern_category
FROM 
    transactions AS t
JOIN 
    riskanalysis AS ra ON t.txregistry = ra.txref
WHERE 
    ra.transaction_pattern_category = 'High-risk';

SELECT 
    t.*,
    (ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category')::TEXT AS transaction_pattern_category
FROM 
    transactions AS t
JOIN 
    riskanalysis AS ra ON t.txregistry = ra.txref
WHERE 
    (ra.network_behavior_analytics->>'transaction_pattern_category')::TEXT = 'High-risk';
